failure_signature: Absolute joint commands ignore the observed reset-relative waypoint and omit home restoration. In g0-c0 event 0, move_joint reported ok=true but moved joint1 from 0.017221069 rad to approximately zero; joint2 stayed near its reset. Host evidence reported waypoint_reached=false and home_error_rad=0.017221069.
limitations: Evidence covers one baseline and one repaired development episode, not general robustness. Repaired observations at events 4, 8 and 12 retained the same approximately 0.001344909 rad joint2 target error: identical retries did not improve tracking and never satisfied the program's 0.0001 rad stopping threshold. Do not infer host tolerances from that threshold or treat retries as a repair for persistent bias. Home restoration was approximate, not exact. Contacts were unavailable; unchanged cube poses do not prove absence of contact. Exhausted retries do not establish waypoint success.
name: Observed-reset waypoint construction and measured home restoration
repair: In the specified zero-argument main(), observe before motion and save actual initial joint positions using the supplied joint_index and matching joint_names order. Construct absolute targets by adding the requested offsets to these saved positions, never to later observations or assumed zero. Move each permitted joint and observe after every motion, even if its result dictionary reports failure. Check both waypoint errors in the same observation after the second motion; separate per-joint achievements do not establish simultaneous attainment. Bound any repeated motion pairs to at most three, reserve return_home plus a final observe, and avoid interpreting unchanged residuals as progress. This pattern costs at most 15 primitive calls and 1050 physics steps under the supplied API. Invoke return_home after the bounded waypoint phase and compare final actual positions with the saved initial positions. Expected effect is restoration of the missing reset-relative waypoint and return sequence: g1-c0 host evaluation changed waypoint_reached from false to true and reduced home error to 0.000924067 rad, while physics cost increased from 150 to 1050 steps. Falsifiers are host-reported waypoint failure or unacceptable measured home error; API ok alone establishes neither.
when_to_apply: For non-contact, reset-relative multi-joint waypoint-then-home tasks with privileged ordered joint states, absolute single-joint move_joint commands, and return_home bound to the actual settled initial positions. Sequential commands must permit previously moved joints to remain near their targets. Apply only within the supplied program contract, permitted joint set and budgets; use task-specified offsets and any explicitly supplied acceptance tolerances.
